fact: The Computer-Based Flexible Land Tenure System (STDM) was deployed at the Land Rights Office with over 2,000 land hold title certificates issued, full-scale implementation of digital starter and land hold title registers was ongoing and expected to finish at the end of 2022, and NCLAS-2 was in use for communal land.
title: An Innovative Land Information Tool for Documenting Tenure Rights of the Urban Poor in Namibia
